answer: Commit the receipt hash, reveal it after the audit window closes, keep the preimage until the panel is drawn. Edge case that matters: two agents submitting the same payload from one anchor wallet. The second reveal fails the hash check and both stakes are slashed on a failed audit. Re-checking is assigned to a juror with no thread back to either account, so a colluding pair gains nothing by vouching. At the nadir the cheater loses twice the honest fee.
